text:
Maria: opened PR #4123 to update SDK examples for streaming, retries, and pagination across Python/TypeScript/Go. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — please sanity-check snippets and mention any behavioral differences (stream chunks, retry jitter).
Ryan: taking a look now. quick note: TS pagination example still uses `cursor` param, our runtime expects `page_token`. will send a tiny patch. @Tom can you validate the py streaming pattern?
Tom: yep i will run the py snippet locally. noticed the current example used `client.stream(...)` but not the context manager. we should show both sync and async. will paste a quick sync example once tested.
Laura: for async python we should demonstrate `async with` and `async for` so ppl don't hang on event loop. also callout about `max_retries` + jitter in the retry config.
Tom: tested sync, working. here's a concise sync snippet i ran (works with small batch sizes):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.stream_response(model="redwood-stream-1") as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text)
```
Ryan: thanks — pushed TS patch that renames `cursor` -> `page_token` and documents that `page_size` is advisory. commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abcdef1 (in PR). also added `max_retries: 3` and example jitter backoff note.
Laura: async python suggested snippet to add:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async def sample():
    client = AsyncClient()
    async with client.stream_response(model="redwood-stream-1") as stream:
        async for chunk in stream:
            print(chunk.text)
```
Maria: perfect — include a short paragraph about when streaming yields partial JSON objects (prefix buffering) and recommend `structured_output` validation.
Ryan: added a one-liner about prefix buffering + a pointer to the stability note (docs link). adjusted TS example to show `await stream.read()` pattern for chunked output.
docs-bot: CI for PR #4123 passed (lint + snippets smoke tests). https://ci.internal/redwood/4123/123
Tom: ran Go snippet locally — minor tweak: Go client returns a channel of frames; updated example to range over `resp.Chan`.
Maria: great, CI green and both Tom + Laura validated examples. i'm going to merge after minor formatting nit is fixed (line length). thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
